subject: general
question: Cash Grant-in-Aid from foreign countries and international organisations are a part of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**revenue receipt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Revenue receipts are the income that the government receives from its normal, day-to-day activities.
 
• These include tax revenues such as income tax, corporate tax, excise duty, and non-tax revenues such as interest receipts, dividends, and profits from public sector enterprises.
 
• Cash Grant-in-Aid from foreign countries and international organizations are considered as non-tax revenues under revenue receipts.
 
• Revenue receipts do not create any liability or lead to a reduction in assets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Non-Planned Revenue Receipt**

 
 
• Non-planned revenue receipts are those which are not included in the planned revenue receipts of the government.
 
• These include items like interest receipts, dividends and profits from public sector enterprises, and other non-tax revenues.
 
 
 
• **Planned Revenue Income**
 
 
• Planned revenue income refers to the income that is expected to be received as per the budgetary plans of the government.
 
• It includes both tax and non-tax revenues that have been planned for in the budget.
 
 
 
• **Capital Receipt**
 
 
• Capital receipts are the income received by the government that either creates liabilities or reduces the assets of the government.
 
• Examples include loans from the public, foreign governments, or international organizations, and disinvestment proceeds.
